(() => {
  const node = document.createElement('div');
  node.style.cssText = 'font:16px/20px serif;width:120px';
  node.innerHTML = 'alpha <span>beta gamma</span> delta';
  document.body.append(node);
  const initial = node.getBoundingClientRect();
  const span = node.querySelector('span');
  span.style.verticalAlign = 'middle';
  let rejected = false;
  try { node.getBoundingClientRect(); }
  catch (error) { rejected = error.message.endsWith('layout unsupported: inline text property (vertical-align): middle'); }
  span.style.verticalAlign = 'baseline';
  const current = node.getBoundingClientRect();
  const recovered = current.height === initial.height && current.width === initial.width;
  node.remove();
  return {rejected,recovered};
})()
